name: Mira
source:
Flair's close aide.

She has an eccentric personality. She is a woman who says crass-like lines with a straight face. 

However, she is a skilled swordsman. If she touches Flare without permission her arm will be cut off in an instant.

She also respects honor. In a way, she may be balances out Flare.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
